title: Planning and Design for Traceway and Leopold Bike and Pedestrian Improvements
short_description: Planning and design for bike path, lighting, and pedestrian crossing improvements in Fitchburg.
project_scope: Planned pedestrian and bicycle corridor improvements in Fitchburg, including a new bike path connection between Traceway Drive and Leopold Way, replacement and addition of streetlights along Traceway Drive to improve nighttime pedestrian visibility, and raised or high-visibility crosswalks at crossings serving Leopold Elementary School and the Hub. Total construction cost is stated as 1.4 million.
services: Planning, design, and engineering services; requested disciplines include landscape architecture, civil engineering, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a local streetscape and path improvement project with limited structural complexity.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, or building structure component is indicated.
- Scope focuses on planning, lighting, and crosswalk upgrades rather than innovative structural engineering.
- Bike and pedestrian infrastructure is generally relevant, but this project appears to be at-grade improvements only.
fee_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines are landscape architecture, civil engineering, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: City of Fitchburg, Fitchburg, Wisconsin, USA. Contact: Tim Voelker. Phone: 608-270-4261. Fax: 608-270-4212. Email: tim.voelker@fitchburgwi.gov.
notes: Advance notice only. RFQ/RFP package expected before 07/01/2029. Source states 'maybe seeking' planning/design/engineering services, so procurement is not yet confirmed. Although the fixed category list does not include general pedestrian/cycle infrastructure, the closest available category is Pedestrian and Bicycle Bridges; however, no bridge is mentioned.
